input: Source ethically made furniture for the nursery

gold.taskTitle: Source ethically made furniture for the nursery
gold.taskDescription: Find and purchase furniture for a nursery that meets ethical sourcing and manufacturing standards.

questions.title: What is your total budget for the nursery furniture?
questions.description: Understand the financial constraints to filter sourcing options accordingly.

questions.title: Which specific furniture pieces do you need to source?
questions.description: Identify the exact items needed, such as a crib, dresser, rocking chair, or changing table.

questions.title: What does 'ethically made' mean to you specifically?
questions.description: Clarify whether ethical priorities include fair labour practices, sustainable materials, non-toxic finishes, certifications, or all of the above.

questions.title: Do you have a preferred style or aesthetic for the nursery?
questions.description: Determine design preferences such as minimalist, Scandinavian, rustic, or a specific colour palette.

questions.title: Are you open to buying second-hand or vintage furniture?
questions.description: Establish whether pre-owned items are an acceptable ethical and budget-friendly option.

questions.title: What is your timeline for having the furniture ready?
questions.description: Understand the deadline, such as a due date or a room setup milestone, to prioritise lead times.

questions.title: Do you prefer to shop locally, nationally, or are you open to international brands?
questions.description: Define the geographic scope of sourcing to narrow down relevant retailers and makers.
